clips.title: The story
paras: In the Horde warlock chain to summon a succubus, Ken'zigla's Draught is bound for Camp Taurajo. The troll apothecary prepared it in the Stonetalon Mountains to save Dogran, a missing operative.

Ken'zigla prepared a second dose after trouble with the first courier. The troll apothecary in the Stonetalon Mountains feared the emissary sent to find medicine for the missing scout Dogran had never returned. His draught is volatile and powerful. Half a dose gives a mortally wounded soldier strength to move without making the wounds bleed anew. The rest must wait until the next day, when it completes the recovery.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I figured there might be another coming to get the draught, so I prepared it anyways.
Here you go, friend. Mind you, you should only give half of it to him! That will give him enough strength to move without bleeding himself dry. Wait a night, then give him the other half.
Anyways, you'll want to bring this to Logmar at Camp Taurajo. From what the first one told me, he should have an idea where this Dogran is.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well, it's about time! Dogran has been dying out there, waiting for this.
We need to get this out to him right away, but most of the grunts stationed here are out on a foraging mission.
